Computer diagnostics for Mercedes, BMW and Audi in Kota Kinabalu

Modern Continental cars report their faults electronically. Computer diagnostics at our Likas workshop reads them before any parts are changed.

Why diagnostics comes first

A warning light can have more than one cause. Computer diagnostics reads the fault records in the car's systems and points the troubleshooting in the right direction on Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi, Volkswagen and other models.

Diagnostics, then coding or repair

When a fault is traced to a module, the next step can be module programming and coding. When it is mechanical, we move on to the repair.
